fluent3d.selection: existing Unicode identity groups only; no score-dependent selection

scope: Licensed 2D + 3D cartoon emoji faces, animals, dragons/frogs/dinosaurs/creatures. Not a representative benchmark of plush photographs or third-party commercial cartoon characters.
leakage: Same Unicode identity in both sources is assigned to one split; exact pixels unique. Similar distinct emoji may remain.
phase_a_train_usage: No hard train image used to fit the encoder or class centers; reserved for optional Phase B.
